title: A three-state Play button and a 9-patch panel in a fixed palette
fixture: local s = Sprite(64, 64, ColorMode.RGB) local p = Palette(16)
for i, h in ipairs(hx) do p:setColor(i - 1, Color(tonumber(h:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(h:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(h:sub(5, 6), 16))) end
steps: /skill:make-ui Make a 'Play' button with normal, hover and pressed states, using this sprite's palette.
Now make a small 48x32 panel in the same style, with 9-patch slices, in the same palette.

criteria.desc: a button sprite with 3 or more state frames and a 9-patch slice
a second sprite with a 9-patch slice (the panel)
the button uses only the palette's colors
